disclaimer: Manual observations are not automatically inferred from probes; never submit secrets.

cases.title: Idle writeback state
cases.steps: Mount a disposable remote; wait until uploads complete; open Mounts → Performance.
cases.expected: RC writeback is idle with queued/active/errors = 0, or visibly unavailable (never fabricated zero).
cases.evidence: Photo of numbers or a short note.

cases.title: Unavailable telemetry
cases.steps: With a disposable mount, disconnect networking or create a reversible provider failure; inspect Performance.
cases.expected: Unknown/unavailable is not represented as idle. Do not force-stop a mount containing pending writes.

cases.title: Idle Stop and Restart
cases.steps: On an empty disposable mount, Stop → Start → Restart in the WebUI, repeat 3 times.
cases.expected: Operations finish; Files app can read the mount again; no FUSE ownership errors.

cases.title: Pending upload blocks unsafe Stop
cases.steps: Copy a disposable 100 MB file into a test mount while deliberately reducing transfer speed; immediately press Stop.
cases.expected: Waits for verified drain or refuses after bound; preserves original content and dirty cache.
cases.evidence: Note timeout or drain and remote final file hash.

cases.title: Restart with pending upload
cases.steps: Repeat a real test upload and press Restart while transfer is pending.
cases.expected: Restart waits/refuses; no partially discarded upload or silent state loss.

cases.title: In-flight WebUI cancellation (known gap)
cases.steps: While a busy writeback check is active, look for a way to cancel after confirmation.
cases.expected: Current implementation has no post-confirmation cancel; mark BLOCKED pending future implementation.
cases.evidence: Confirm UI behavior only; do not force-kill daemon.

cases.title: Live transfer dashboard
cases.steps: Expand Performance, copy 50–100 MB into a disposable mount, watch the graph.
cases.expected: Aggregate speed and bytes respond; rate is not mislabeled download/upload direction.

cases.title: Stop background monitoring
cases.steps: Close Performance, switch page, hide KernelSU WebUI for 1 minute, return.
cases.expected: No ongoing WebUI polling while hidden; normal status resumes on return.
cases.evidence: Approx request counts if measured, otherwise observational note.

cases.title: PID-safe restart charts
cases.steps: Expand Performance while traffic runs; Restart the idle mount, reopen Performance.
cases.expected: No stale graph from previous mount PID; new process starts a fresh history.

cases.title: Documents and streaming profiles
cases.steps: On a disposable mount, compare Documents and Streaming effective settings.
cases.expected: Editor preview reflects selected options; guarded restart applies settings.

cases.title: Read-only profile
cases.steps: Apply Read-only to a disposable mount; try creating a test file from Files.
cases.expected: Read succeeds; write fails; remove profile and confirm normal write returns.

cases.title: Dirty-cache preservation
cases.steps: With a pending test upload, inspect Cache controls; never manually delete the VFS cache.
cases.expected: Unverified stopped cache cannot be cleared, pruned or forgotten, even under storage pressure.

cases.title: Cache pressure and limits
cases.steps: On a test mount inspect cache use, configured max and min-free-space.
cases.expected: High/normal/unknown advice behaves honestly; soft limits not presented as guaranteed hard quota.
cases.evidence: Measured cache MiB and phone free GiB.

cases.title: Wi-Fi reconnect recovery
cases.steps: Start a mount, disable Wi-Fi for 30 sec, then reconnect; browse a harmless test folder.
cases.expected: Supervisor recovers when permitted; error/backoff not reset repeatedly.

cases.title: Explicit Stop persists
cases.steps: Manually Stop a mount, toggle Wi-Fi off/on, wait two minutes.
cases.expected: Mount remains stopped; no surprise restart.

cases.title: Reboot and battery state
cases.steps: With desired mount enabled and Wi-Fi allowed, reboot once. Separately measure a normal 20-min screen-off interval.
cases.expected: Mount recovers within policy; no retry storm. Battery baseline recorded, not estimated.
cases.evidence: Recovery seconds and battery percent start/end.

cases.title: Keep file and folder offline
cases.steps: Pin a small text file and a 2–3 file folder from a disposable remote in Offline files.
cases.expected: Tasks finish; pinned file count and checksum statuses are verified.

cases.title: Airplane-mode export
cases.steps: Before going offline pin a test file; enable airplane mode; verify status and Export copy.
cases.expected: Complete verified private pin exports into Downloads without network.
cases.evidence: SHA256 of original and exported file (no contents).

cases.title: Publish offline view
cases.steps: With 3 verified pins, publish offline files view, then open its folder in Android Files offline.
cases.expected: Browsable verified copies under Downloads/Skybind-Offline-Views; cloud mount unchanged.

cases.title: Stale remote identity blocks public export
cases.steps: On a disposable config only, pin a file, repoint that mount to a different test remote, attempt export.
cases.expected: Export refuses a pin from the previous remote; no new public copy produced.
cases.evidence: Error label only; restore original remote afterward.

cases.title: True same-path offline FUSE read (known gap)
cases.steps: After pinning, go to airplane mode and try the original cloud mount path (not Downloads view).
cases.expected: Do not require success; transparent same-path FUSE fallback is NOT implemented. Mark BLOCKED.

cases.title: Offline draft and persistent queue
cases.steps: Pin a small text file; Edit offline in airplane mode; change only a disposable line; Queue edited draft. Reboot and inspect queue.
cases.expected: Private staged edit persists and is checksummed; original remote untouched.

cases.title: Conflict detection
cases.steps: After queuing an edit, change the original test remote on another client; reconnect and select Review edits.
cases.expected: Conflict is shown; no overwrite or automatic upload of original.

cases.title: Separate-copy upload
cases.steps: On disposable data explicitly approve Upload separate copy; inspect destination.
cases.expected: Original unchanged; only Skybind-Offline-Edits/<id>/ copy uploaded after approval.
cases.evidence: Both original and copy SHA256; redact path/ID.

cases.title: Reconnect review opt-in
cases.steps: Enable automatic reconnect review; queue a test edit; toggle network and inspect review after a few minutes.
cases.expected: Metadata review runs at most once per five minutes; no automatic uploads.

cases.title: Uncertain transfer outcome
cases.steps: Simulate interruption of a small separate-copy upload to disposable remote if safe.
cases.expected: Indeterminate operation requires review; no unapproved automatic retry.
cases.evidence: Review-required status; skip if disruption unsafe.

cases.title: Export backup with no credentials
cases.steps: Settings → Personal backup & restore → Export; inspect JSON locally.
cases.expected: Mounts/profiles/preferences/pin references included; passwords, queued edits and private offline contents absent.
cases.evidence: Backup file size and checksum (do not upload raw backup).

cases.title: Preview and disabled restore
cases.steps: Back up disposable configuration; change only a test mount; Preview restore; confirm disabled mounts.
cases.expected: Restore is guarded; imported mounts are disabled and cannot auto-connect.

cases.title: Preference restore separately
cases.steps: Change a harmless UI setting, then import backup preferences separately.
cases.expected: UI setting restored with separate confirmation; mount restore result remains independent.

cases.title: Credential migration (known gap)
cases.steps: Check backup contents for credential-transfer ability.
cases.expected: Encrypted credentials are intentionally excluded and migration is not implemented; mark BLOCKED.

cases.title: Daily use from Android Files
cases.steps: Play a small video/seek; browse a 50+ file folder; copy and delete a disposable small test file through ordinary Files app.
cases.expected: Normal app access still works without granting it root; media and file operations succeed.

cases.title: Mounts UI and log follow
cases.steps: Check Keep offline / Cache / Details, open Logs, disable Follow, hide WebUI.
cases.expected: Actions remain accessible; Follow-off stops log timer; compact layout usable.

cases.title: Storage and idle battery sample
cases.steps: Record phone battery before/after 60 min with WebUI hidden, plus Skybind RAM and total cache/pins/views use if measurable.
cases.expected: Numbers are recorded as measured, never made-up; no uncontrolled storage growth.
cases.evidence: Battery percent, RAM MiB, storage MiB.

cases.title: Integrated reboot recovery
cases.steps: One reboot with a pinned file and a queued draft; reconnect and inspect mount, pin, and draft.
cases.expected: Mount recovers per policy; pin and queued draft survive; private cache preserved.
